title: Artifact source catalog
description: Versioned definitions of the evidence sources supported by Hephaestus.

version.description: Source-contract version that fixes the meaning of every entry in this catalog.

sources.description: Logical evidence sources with stable identifiers and governed capture semantics.

sourceKind.description: Stable machine identifier for one logical evidence source.

kind.description: Stable machine identifier for this logical evidence source.

displayName.description: Human-readable source name for authoring and operator interfaces.

description.description: Plain-language summary of the source content.

selectionScope.description: Exact object, fields, limits, ordering, and exclusions captured by this source.

artifactKinds.description: Types of reviewed work for which this source is meaningful.

authority.description: Relationship between the captured representation and its origin.

identity.description: Whether a capture of this source can be anchored to an identity that cannot drift.

completeness.description: Completeness and valid-empty states the source can represent.

requiredQuality.description: What a practice that requires this source is thereby requiring of the capture.

privacyClass.description: Minimum privacy risk class of the source content.

retentionPolicy.description: Closed retention policy governing captured evidence.

erasurePolicy.description: Closed erasure policy governing source and derived content.

useDecisionIds.description: Purpose-specific governance decisions that cover this source.

supportedAbsenceStates.description: Non-available outcomes the runtime can represent for this source.

defaultRequirement.description: Whether a practice bound to one of this source's artifact kinds reads it unless its author says otherwise. The starting evidence of a kind, stated by the sources themselves rather than by a per-kind list somewhere that has to be edited when a kind is added.

source.description: Authority, capture, quality, privacy, retention, erasure, and absence semantics for one evidence source.

mode.description: PINNED_IDENTITY: the capture is anchored to an immutable upstream identity and cannot drift. NOT_APPLICABLE: nothing available can demonstrate currentness, so no practice may require it.

identity.description: Whether the runtime can demonstrate that captured evidence is current.

supportsComplete.description: Whether the runtime can establish complete capture of the selected scope.

supportsPartial.description: Whether bounded or truncated capture is supported.

supportsEmpty.description: Whether a successful complete capture may legitimately contain no logical items.

completeness.description: Which completeness and valid-empty states this source can represent.
